scope: Bounded, verification-free ASN.1, X.509, CMS and timestamp parsing in pagura-pki. Expected results derive from X.690 and the RFC schemas; parsing establishes no integrity, trust, validity at a time or revocation status (ADR 0015).

requirements.gaps: A generic reader cannot tell SET from SET OF or recognise IMPLICIT types and DEFAULT fields; the typed schemas apply those checks. Unknown universal types fail with an explicit feature.

clauses: X.690 8.1.3.6 indefinite length, 10.1 length form, 10.2 constructed strings
requirements.gaps: Only indefinite constructed lengths, nonminimal definite lengths and constructed OCTET STRINGs are tolerated, each as a reported repair. This is not a complete BER decoder.

clauses: 4.1 certificate fields, versions, unique identifiers and validity
requirements.gaps: Serial-number profile, the UTCTime/GeneralizedTime choice by year and name matching belong to validation.
Extensions without a typed view stay available as DER trees; recognising an extension is the caller's explicit decision.
CRL signatures, freshness and extension semantics are not evaluated.

clauses: 5.1-5.4 SignedData, SignerInfo, signed attributes and their signature input
requirements.gaps: No digest or signature is computed or verified; embedded certificates never become trusted.
Timestamp tokens are not authenticated and the imprint is not compared.
Envelope only; curve-order ranges and the signature equation belong to pagura-crypto.

clauses: RFC 5280 6.1 basic path validation and 6.2 path building inputs
requirements.gaps: Trust anchors, evaluation time and signature verification are caller-supplied. Directory names compare byte-identical values or ASCII caseIgnore values; other repertoires stay indeterminate. PKITS runs only with the private reference cache.
Offline CRLs only; OCSP is deferred and no distribution point is dereferenced.
